items.prompt: Black to move. White's bishop on g5 pins the knight on f6 to the queen. Before asking the bishop a question with ...h6, check whether the centre can open. Is Black's d5 pawn already attacked by a White pawn? Predict, then check.

claims.statement: One White pawn (e4) attacks d5.
One White man (the bishop on g5) attacks f6.

hints: Two things matter here: which White man attacks f6, and what White's pawns attack in the centre.
Look at the pawns on e4 and d4 and the squares they attack.
The pawn on e4 attacks d5 and f5.
items.explain: The e4 pawn attacks d5, so White can open the centre by capturing or pushing [V]. The bishop on g5 is the only White man attacking f6 [V].

items.prompt: Black to move. Black asks the pinning bishop a question with 1...h6. No White pawn attacks d5, so the centre cannot open at once. Is ...h6 among the engine's sound moves? Predict, then check.

claims.statement: No White pawn attacks d5.
The engine's best move is in {...c5, ...h6} and both are within 40 cp of it.

hints: Check whether any White pawn attacks the centre pawn on d5.
If the centre cannot open, the bishop cannot come back to life easily after ...h6.
The engine lists ...c5 first and ...h6 close behind.
items.explain: With no pawn attacking d5, ...h6 is one of the engine's two best moves [V]. That agrees with the rule of thumb: ask when the centre cannot open at once.

items.prompt: Two changes: White has a pawn on c4 and a knight on c3, so d5 is attacked twice. Black asks again with 1...h6. Does the question hold (is ...h6 within 40 cp of the engine's best)? Predict, then check.

claims.statement: The c4 pawn attacks d5.

...h6 is at least 70 cp worse than the engine's best move.

hints: Compare with the last board: what attacks d5 now?
A pawn on c4 and a knight on c3 both press on d5.
The question costs a lot here.
items.explain: A pawn on c4 and a knight on c3 both press on d5. The engine rates ...h6 at least 70 cp below its best move, and its line runs ...h6 Bxf6 gxf6 cxd5 exd5 [V]. Which of the two changes does the damage was not separated, and the cause of the full loss was not checked.
